name: Agent Integration Reminder
description: Owns the optional, non-modal, device-local reminder that explains when one installed local terminal Agent can gain richer Orchbee status observation and routes the user to explicit integration management without changing Agent configuration.

states: Inspect the light English non-modal reminder for an installed local Codex whose Orchbee integration is not enabled. Review integration hides the reminder and opens the Agent integrations Settings destination; the close control persists a per-Agent dismissal.
Inspect Simplified Chinese copy and the dark non-modal reminder for a locally available Grok integration that the user previously disabled.

useWhen: Desktop has read-only evidence that a supported local Agent is available and its conflict-free Orchbee observation integration is not installed or is disabled.
A user should discover richer Agent status without an automatic install, an operating-system notification, or a modal interruption.
avoidWhen: The Agent runs on a remote host, integration inspection is ambiguous, a conflicting entry exists, or the integration requires a manual compatibility decision.
The message reports an active Agent task state such as waiting for input, completion, or failure; those states use tab and Workbench Agent presentation instead.
invariants: Rendering, opening, and dismissing the reminder never invokes an Agent CLI, writes Agent configuration, requests system-notification permission, or changes a remote host.
At most one eligible integration reminder is offered during one application session, using the canonical Agent order.
Dismissal is explicit, device-local, persisted per Agent integration, bounded to the closed integration registry, and safe to lose.
Review integration hides the reminder and opens the Agent integrations Settings category; only a later explicit Settings action can enable or disable an integration.
An explicit Settings disable records dismissal before attempting the exact Orchbee-owned removal, while a verified successful enable clears that Agent's persisted dismissal for future external drift.
Only locally available, managed, conflict-free integrations in not-installed or disabled state are eligible; remote, unknown, unsupported, failed-inspection, and conflicting states remain silent.
The reminder is non-modal, announces itself politely, retains a labeled close action, and never steals focus.
